note: Reminders computed from age, sex, smoking, BMI, problems and medicines; confirm in the record what has already been done.

aafp.label: AAFP 2026–2027 respiratory vaccine recommendations for adults

items.name: Colorectal cancer screening
items.detail: Adults 45–75 (USPSTF A for 50–75, B for 45–49, May 2021).

items.name: Breast cancer screening
items.detail: Biennial mammography for women 40–74 (USPSTF B, April 2024).

items.name: Cervical cancer screening
items.detail: Ages 21–29: cytology every 3 years. Ages 30–65: cytology every 3 years, high-risk HPV testing every 5 years, or cotesting every 5 years (USPSTF A, August 2018).

items.name: Lung cancer screening
items.detail: Annual low-dose CT for adults 50–80 with a 20 pack-year history who smoke or quit within 15 years (USPSTF B, March 2021).

items.name: Abdominal aortic aneurysm screening
items.detail: One-time ultrasound for men 65–75 who have ever smoked (USPSTF B, December 2019).

items.name: Prediabetes and type 2 diabetes screening
items.detail: Adults 35–70 with overweight or obesity (USPSTF B, August 2021).

items.name: Statin for primary prevention
items.detail: Adults 40–75 with at least one risk factor (dyslipidemia, diabetes, hypertension or smoking) and an estimated 10-year cardiovascular risk of 10% or more (USPSTF B, August 2022). Estimate the risk before deciding.

items.name: Hypertension screening
items.detail: Office blood pressure, confirmed outside the clinic before diagnosis (USPSTF A, April 2021).

items.name: Depression screening
items.detail: Adults, including pregnant and postpartum people (USPSTF B, June 2023).

items.name: Anxiety screening
items.detail: Adults 64 and younger, including pregnant and postpartum people (USPSTF B, June 2023).

items.name: Falls prevention
items.detail: Exercise interventions for community-dwelling adults 65 and older at increased risk of falls (USPSTF B, June 2024).

items.name: Osteoporosis screening
items.detail: Women 65 and older (USPSTF B, January 2025).

items.name: Osteoporosis screening (if postmenopausal and at increased risk)
items.detail: Postmenopausal women younger than 65 at increased risk, judged with a formal clinical risk assessment tool (USPSTF B, January 2025).

items.name: Hepatitis C screening (once)
items.detail: Adults 18–79 (USPSTF B, March 2020).

items.name: HIV screening
items.detail: Adolescents and adults 15–65 (USPSTF A, June 2019).

items.name: Influenza vaccine
items.detail: One dose every season for all adults; at 65 and older, a high-dose, adjuvanted or recombinant vaccine is preferred.

items.name: COVID-19 vaccine (2026–27)
items.detail: Guidance differs: CDC advises individual-based decision-making with a clinician; AAFP's 2026–27 recommendations advise the updated vaccine for adults, with two doses six months apart at 65 and older.

items.name: Tdap/Td booster
items.detail: Tdap once, then Td or Tdap every 10 years.

items.name: Recombinant zoster vaccine
items.detail: Two doses for adults 50 and older.

items.name: Pneumococcal vaccine
items.detail: Adults 50 and older (PCV20 or PCV21 alone, or PCV15 followed by PPSV23).

items.name: RSV vaccine
items.detail: A single dose, not repeated, for adults 75 and older; also 50–74 at increased risk.
